interpretation.positive: The two intervention-defined computational states occupy a strongly organized raw hidden-state geometry. A learned boundary-normal perturbation changes causal response class at matched norm while an orthogonal perturbation does not.
interpretation.important_limit: Crossing the linear geometric boundary often lands in a fuzzy off-manifold response state (about 20% mean Hamming distance to the nearest canonical response signature). The linear axis identifies a causally sensitive direction, not a clean generative coordinate for valid carry states.
